requirement: Website Opportunities after #1427: the QA reader follows nav links written to the published hostname (WordPress), a later research swaps stored feed-size Facebook photos for their originals, and the hand-off door queues its prompt into the site's chat itself

oracle.ref: PR #1435 (fix); fix evidence: Stand wo, 18–19/10/2026: wp-marigold1 qa.pages = ["/"] with discover on (menu links are absolute to wp-marigold1.wo.tracy.test:46080, the reader opened a loopback address); Fern Station re-research kept 103 stored Facebook photos at ≤ 1419 px because the source was complete; qa-marigold3's prompt waited 40 min for a page that never settled (tasks/plan-website-opportunities-pictures.md §11–12).
oracle.invariant: navPathsOf keeps '/menu', '/about/', '/gallery?x=1' from a page on 127.0.0.1:5000 when the published host is wp-marigold1.wo.tracy.test (absolute menu links, case-insensitive host), and drops home, index.php, a .pdf, evil.test and facebook.com; without the published host only the page's own origin counts. Executor: research 1 stores the Facebook feed copy (width 60) when its photo page is down; research 2 (source already complete, nothing collected) stores the original (width 1280, source_url the ctp=s1280x720 address) and marks the feed row status 'reference', reason 'superseded'; progress.media.upgraded = 1; coverage.photoPages = {tried: 2, upgraded: 1}; collected.media[0].url is the original and fallbackUrl the feed copy; research 3 reads no photo page and changes nothing. Doors: the first hand-off press with no site row queues no prompt and answers no promptSent; the press after the site row exists queues exactly one prompt into the held chat 'wo-demo-<buildId>' with requestId 'wo-handoff:<buildId>:wo-demo-<buildId>' and the handoff's own prompt text, answers next '/<site>/s/wo-demo-<buildId>' and handoff.promptSent {at, sessionId: 'wo-demo-<buildId>'}; a third press makes no new chat, queues nothing more and keeps promptSent; GET …/handoff returns promptSent. Doors: a chat that refuses the prompt fails closed: 503 HANDOFF_PROMPT_FAILED, nothing left for the page to send; the next press queues it again and promptSent names the session it went to. Client handoff-entry: the page never sends a prompt. An old wo-handoff address only reads the server receipt and loses the parameter: with promptSent it reports nothing, without it HANDOFF_NOT_READY; neither drafts nor submits. Every test named in run.tests reports ok and the command exits 0.
